d: Matdataon ke vishesh gahan punrikshan yani SIR ko lekar ek taraph rajnitik virodh chal raha hai, vahin dusri or chunav aayog votar list ko svachchh va pardarshi banane ke lie yuvaon aur bhavi matdataon se sujhav mangne men juta hai. bharat nirvachan aayog ke nirdesh par jharkhand men chal rahe aavaj jharkhand 2026 ke tahat chaynit tin sarvashreshth vidyarthiyon ko rashtriy matdata divas ke avsar par sammanit karne ke sath-sath puraskrit bhi kiya jaega.
